Controls are not widgets, Live Activities, or App Intents

iOS 18 marketing blurs four surfaces indie teams conflate. AppLocale covers listing metadata only — layer 1.

  • Control Center controls (this page) — quick toggles and buttons in Control Center and Lock Screen control slots. Gallery frames often show the Add Control picker, control tiles, and toggle labels.
  • Home Screen / Lock Screen widgets (different) — widget gallery sizes and StandBy previews. See Home & Lock Screen widgets listing guide — not Control Center controls.
  • Live Activities (different) — time-bound Lock Screen and Dynamic Island updates. See Live Activities listing guide — not control toggles.
  • App Intents / Siri / Shortcuts (different) — voice and Shortcuts automation marketing is separate from Control Center control tiles on the product page.

Your screenshots may show multiple surfaces in one gallery. Listing copy should name the correct one per frame — control customization sheets are not widget pickers and not Live Activity banners.

Common mistakes on Control Center app zh-Hans listings

  • Translating only the description — name, subtitle, and keywords still English while Control Center screenshots dominate the gallery
  • Calling controls “widgets” — buyers searching for 小组件 expect Home Screen widgets; mislabeling Control Center toggles confuses the feature story
  • Pasting 控制中心 into every keyword slot — crowding the 100-character field without room for your app’s actual use case (habit, smart home, audio)
  • English control titles in PNG exports — Connect caption fields are zh-Hans but burned-in sample control names on the image file are still Latin
  • Assuming Controls API localization = listing done — runtime control strings can be Chinese while the App Store row still falls back to English
  • What's New still English after controls launch — see What's New in Simplified Chinese when iOS 18 controls shipped in a recent version
  • ChatGPT 翻译腔 on Control Center jargon — literal translations of “toggle” or “control widget” that native readers do not use in App Store copy

What good zh-Hans Control Center listing copy looks like

Listing fields should name the control surfaces you actually ship — aligned with your screenshot order:

  • Subtitle — one concrete promise: “控制中心一键开关” or “锁屏快捷控制，无需解锁” — not vague “提升效率”
  • Keywords — mix category terms (待办, 专注, 智能家居) with control intent (控制中心, 锁屏) within Connect’s ~100-character zh-Hans budget; see Simplified Chinese keywords guide
  • Description — short paragraphs for Control Center toggles, Lock Screen control slots, and Action button workflows if you market them — mirror screenshot sequence
  • Screenshot captions on control frames — name the on-screen action: “长按添加控制项到控制中心” not “强大功能”
  • Sample control titles in caption lines — when your gallery shows example toggles, caption sheet lists zh-Hans equivalents; include English control names in your brief if you want a reference title list
  • Voice consistency — same 你/您 choice as your description across overlay lines and promotional text
